title: KODEX — KFUSE: MULTIFID
description:
KODEX — KFUSE (MULTIFID). multi-fidelity surrogate: cheap analytic low-fidelity + a residual GP correction from the mu=400 CGYRO points; real-mass gold is the 3rd fidelity

Benchmark: multi-fidelity: RMSE 1.481→1.05 (R²=0.787); 3rd fidelity = real-mass gold (deferred)

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)). Honest card preserved verbatim.
